title: Numbers Chapter 18 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Numbers chapter 18 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Numbers Chapter 18 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Numbers Chapter 18.

questions.question: Who did the LORD say shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary in Numbers 18?
options: Aaron and his sons
The tribe of Judah
The children of Israel
The elders of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and his sons
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:1 states that Aaron and his sons and his father's house shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary.

questions.question: Which tribe did the LORD instruct Aaron to bring to minister with him?
options: The tribe of Levi
The tribe of Benjamin
The tribe of Ephraim
The tribe of Dan
questions.correctAnswer: The tribe of Levi
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:2 commands Aaron to bring his brethren of the tribe of Levi to minister with him.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites were allowed to come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:3 says the Levites shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, lest they die.

questions.question: What were the Levites joined to Aaron to do?
options: Keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation
Offer sacrifices
Lead the children of Israel
Collect tithes
questions.correctAnswer: Keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:4 states that the Levites were joined to Aaron to keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation.

questions.question: What was the purpose of Aaron and his sons keeping the charge of the sanctuary and altar?
options: So that there be no wrath upon the children of Israel
To collect offerings
To lead the Israelites in battle
To maintain the ark only
questions.correctAnswer: So that there be no wrath upon the children of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:5 explains that keeping the charge of the sanctuary and altar was to prevent wrath upon Israel.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites were given to Aaron as a gift from among the children of Israel.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:6 clearly states that the Levites were taken from Israel and given to Aaron as a gift for the LORD.

questions.question: What will happen if a stranger comes near to the priest's office?
options: They shall be put to death
They shall be blessed
They shall be given a sacrifice
They shall be sent away
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:7 states that any stranger coming near the priest's office shall be put to death.

questions.question: What has the LORD given Aaron charge over, because of the anointing?
options: The heave offerings of all hallowed things of Israel
The land of Canaan
The leadership of Israel
The ark of the covenant
questions.correctAnswer: The heave offerings of all hallowed things of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:8 says the LORD gave Aaron charge of the heave offerings of all the hallowed things of Israel because of the anointing.

questions.question: True or False: Aaron and his sons shall eat the most holy things reserved from the fire.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:9 confirms that the most holy things, including offerings, shall be for Aaron and his sons.

questions.question: Where shall Aaron eat the most holy things?
options: In the most holy place
Outside the camp
In the city of Jerusalem
In the tabernacle courtyard
questions.correctAnswer: In the most holy place
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:10 states Aaron shall eat the most holy things in the most holy place.

questions.question: Who among Aaron’s family are allowed to eat the heave offering and wave offerings?
options: Aaron, his sons, and his daughters
Only Aaron
Only his sons
Only the priests of other tribes
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron, his sons, and his daughters
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:11 specifies that the heave offerings and wave offerings are given to Aaron, his sons, and his daughters.

questions.question: Which comes first in Numbers 18: the Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle or the LORD giving Aaron charge of the heave offerings?
options: Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle
LORD giving Aaron charge of the heave offerings
Both happen simultaneously
Neither is mentioned
questions.correctAnswer: Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:2-4 describe the Levites keeping the charge before Numbers 18:8 where the LORD gives Aaron charge of heave offerings.

questions.question: True or False: A stranger is allowed to minister before the tabernacle of witness along with Aaron and his sons.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:4 commands that a stranger shall not come near to minister with Aaron and his sons.

questions.question: What role do Aaron and his sons hold according to Numbers 18:7?
options: Priest's office
King's office
Scribe's office
Warrior's office
questions.correctAnswer: Priest's office
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:7 states that Aaron and his sons shall keep their priest's office and serve within the vail.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Aaron and his sons bearing the iniquity of their priesthood?
options: To serve as a gift of service to the LORD
To lead the armies
To judge the people
To collect taxes
questions.correctAnswer: To serve as a gift of service to the LORD
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:1-7 explain the priesthood is a service given as a gift to bear iniquity and serve the LORD.

medium.title: Numbers Chapter 18 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Numbers Chapter 18 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:12, what are the best things given to Aaron?
options: All the best of the oil, wine, and wheat firstfruits
All the tithes from Israel
The entire tabernacle service
The firstborn of every beast
questions.correctAnswer: All the best of the oil, wine, and wheat firstfruits
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:12 states that all the best of the oil, wine, and wheat, which are the firstfruits offered unto the LORD, are given to Aaron. This is specified as a distinct gift apart from tithes or other offerings.

questions.question: What does Numbers 18:13 say about what is first ripe in the land?
options: It belongs to the priests, and all who are clean in their house may eat of it
It must be given to the Levites exclusively
It should be offered entirely on the altar
It should be sold and the money given to the poor
questions.correctAnswer: It belongs to the priests, and all who are clean in their house may eat of it
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:13 explains that whatever is first ripe in the land, brought unto the LORD, is the priests' portion, and everyone who is clean in the priest's house may eat of it, highlighting the sanctity and sharing within the priestly household.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:14, what is said about everything devoted in Israel?
options: It shall be the priests’
It shall be destroyed
It shall be given to the Levites
It shall be shared among all tribes
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be the priests’
questions.explanation: Verse 14 clearly states that everything devoted in Israel is given to the priests, signifying their portion and responsibility in the offerings and sacred items.

questions.question: What does Numbers 18:15 say about the firstborn that openeth the matrix in all flesh?
options: They belong to the priests but the firstborn of man and unclean beasts must be redeemed
They belong to the Levites exclusively
They must be sacrificed without exception
They are to be given to the poor
questions.correctAnswer: They belong to the priests but the firstborn of man and unclean beasts must be redeemed
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:15 teaches that all firstborn that open the womb belong to the priests; however, the firstborn of man and unclean animals must be redeemed, distinguishing between holy offerings and redemption obligations.

questions.question: How much money is to be paid for redeeming those to be redeemed from a month old, according to Numbers 18:16?
options: Five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary
Ten shekels, according to the king's standard
One shekel, as a token price
No money is required for redemption
questions.correctAnswer: Five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:16 specifies that those to be redeemed from a month old must be redeemed for five shekels according to the sanctuary's shekel, showing a regulated system of valuation for redemption.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:17, which firstlings are not to be redeemed and what is to be done with them?
options: Firstlings of cows, sheep, and goats are holy; their blood is sprinkled on the altar and fat burned as a sweet savour
Only firstborn calves are not to be redeemed and must be sold
All firstlings must be redeemed with money
Firstlings of unclean beasts must be sacrificed without burning
questions.correctAnswer: Firstlings of cows, sheep, and goats are holy; their blood is sprinkled on the altar and fat burned as a sweet savour
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:17 explains that the firstlings of cows, sheep, and goats are holy and not to be redeemed; their blood is to be sprinkled on the altar and their fat burned as an offering made by fire, signifying their sanctity.

questions.question: What portion of the firstlings described in Numbers 18:18 belongs to the priests?
options: The flesh, as the wave breast and the right shoulder
Only the blood
The entire animal is burnt
They receive no portion
questions.correctAnswer: The flesh, as the wave breast and the right shoulder
questions.explanation: Verse 18 states that the flesh of the firstlings belongs to the priests, specifically as the wave breast and the right shoulder, portions designated as their due from offerings.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:19, what kind of covenant is made between the LORD and Aaron's family regarding the heave offerings?
options: A covenant of salt forever
A temporary covenant for a generation
A covenant sealed with blood once
No covenant is mentioned
questions.correctAnswer: A covenant of salt forever
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:19 describes the covenant concerning the heave offerings as a 'covenant of salt forever,' symbolizing an enduring, unbreakable agreement between the LORD and Aaron's descendants.

questions.question: What does the LORD say about Aaron's inheritance in the land of Israel in Numbers 18:20?
options: He shall have no inheritance among them; the LORD is his inheritance
He shall receive a large land inheritance
He will inherit all the cities of refuge
He will inherit the same as the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: He shall have no inheritance among them; the LORD is his inheritance
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:20 clarifies that Aaron shall have no inheritance or land among the Israelites because the LORD Himself is his portion and inheritance, indicating spiritual rather than material inheritance.

questions.question: What has been given to the children of Levi as their inheritance, according to Numbers 18:21?
options: All the tenth in Israel for their service in the tabernacle
Land and cities throughout Israel
The firstborn animals of the herd
The spoils of war
questions.correctAnswer: All the tenth in Israel for their service in the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21 states that the Levites have been given all the tithe (tenth) in Israel as their inheritance, in return for their service in the tabernacle, emphasizing their dependence on God’s provision.

questions.question: What warning is given in Numbers 18:22 about the children of Israel coming near the tabernacle?
options: They must not come near or they will bear sin and die
They are welcome to enter anytime
They should only come during festivals
They must bring offerings before entering
questions.correctAnswer: They must not come near or they will bear sin and die
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:22 warns that the children of Israel must not approach the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin and die, underscoring the holiness and separation required around the sanctuary.

questions.question: How does Numbers 18:23 explain the Levites' inheritance and responsibility regarding the tabernacle?
options: Levites have no land inheritance but bear their iniquity in service to the tabernacle
Levites inherit land in every tribe
Levites have no duties in the tabernacle
Levites serve only during festivals
questions.correctAnswer: Levites have no land inheritance but bear their iniquity in service to the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:23 explains that Levites are not given an inheritance of land among Israel but are responsible for the service of the tabernacle and bear the iniquity of their service, establishing their unique role.

questions.question: What does Numbers 18:24 say about the tithes of the children of Israel?
options: They are given to the Levites to inherit
They must be burnt as a sacrifice
They belong to the priests only
They are to be distributed among the poor
questions.correctAnswer: They are given to the Levites to inherit
questions.explanation: According to Numbers 18:24, the tithes offered by the children of Israel are given to the Levites as their inheritance, reinforcing their dependence on these offerings in lieu of land.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:26, what portion of the tithes must the Levites offer as a heave offering to the LORD?
options: A tenth part of the tithe
Half of the tithe
All of the tithe
None, the tithe is only for them
questions.correctAnswer: A tenth part of the tithe
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:26 instructs the Levites to offer a tenth part of the tithes they receive from the children of Israel as a heave offering to the LORD, showing a principle of giving from what they have received.

questions.question: What is the outcome promised in Numbers 18:32 if the Levites properly offer the best of the tithes and do not pollute the holy things?
options: They shall bear no sin and shall not die
They will receive land inheritance
They will be exempt from service
They shall be given riches among the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: They shall bear no sin and shall not die
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:32 promises that if the Levites properly offer the best of the tithes and do not pollute the holy things of Israel, they shall bear no sin by reason of it and shall not die, emphasizing obedience and reverence.

hard.title: Numbers Chapter 18 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Numbers Chapter 18.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18, what is the inheritance of Aaron and his sons among the children of Israel?
options: A portion of the land
The LORD Himself as their inheritance
Gold and silver
A share of the crops
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD Himself as their inheritance
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:20 states that Aaron and his sons shall have no inheritance in the land of Israel because the LORD Himself is their part and inheritance.

questions.question: What did the LORD give the Levites as their inheritance in Numbers 18?
options: A portion of the land of Canaan
All the tithes in Israel
Gold and silver offerings
The cities of refuge
questions.correctAnswer: All the tithes in Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21 declares that the LORD gave the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance for their service in the tabernacle.

questions.question: What must the Levites do from the tithes they receive from the children of Israel?
options: Offer a tenth part as a heave offering to the LORD
Keep all the tithes for themselves
Give half to the poor
Sacrifice it entirely on the altar
questions.correctAnswer: Offer a tenth part as a heave offering to the LORD
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:26 instructs the Levites to offer a tenth part of the tithes they receive as a heave offering to the LORD.

questions.question: How is the heave offering of the Levites' tithe to be reckoned, according to Numbers 18?
options: As a small and insignificant gift
As the corn of the threshingfloor and the fulness of the winepress
As a burden to be avoided
As a private donation
questions.correctAnswer: As the corn of the threshingfloor and the fulness of the winepress
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:27 compares the heave offering to the fullness and abundance represented by the corn of the threshingfloor and the winepress, symbolizing its value.

questions.question: Who is to receive the LORD'S heave offering from the Levites’ tithes?
options: The priests, specifically Aaron
The king of Israel
The elders of Israel
The Levites themselves
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, specifically Aaron
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:28 states that the Levites shall give the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest from the tithes they receive.

questions.question: What must be done with the best part of the gifts offered to the LORD by the Levites?
options: It must be offered as a heave offering unto the LORD
It should be sold to fund the temple
It should be stored for famine
It should be eaten by the Levites only at Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: It must be offered as a heave offering unto the LORD
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:29 commands that the best part of all gifts must be offered as a heave offering unto the LORD, emphasizing holiness and dedication.

questions.question: How are the heaved best portions counted for the Levites according to Numbers 18?
options: As a burden and taxation
As the increase of the threshingfloor and winepress
As a minor feast
As a loan to be repaid
questions.correctAnswer: As the increase of the threshingfloor and winepress
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:30 explains that the heaved best portions are counted as the increase of the threshingfloor and winepress, symbolizing abundance and blessing.

questions.question: Where are the Levites and their households permitted to eat the portions given to them for their service?
options: Only at the tabernacle
In every place
Only in the city of Jerusalem
Only during festivals
questions.correctAnswer: In every place
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:31 states that the Levites and their households may eat these portions in every place as their reward for service in the tabernacle.

questions.question: What consequence is warned if the Levites pollute the holy things of the children of Israel?
options: They shall be banished
They shall lose their inheritance
They shall die
They shall be fined
questions.correctAnswer: They shall die
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:32 warns that if the Levites pollute the holy things of Israel, they shall die, underscoring the sanctity of their duties.

questions.question: True or False: According to Numbers 18, the Levites are allowed to have an inheritance of land among the children of Israel.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:23 clearly states that the Levites shall have no inheritance among the children of Israel, as their inheritance is the tithes given to them.

questions.question: True or False: Numbers 18 teaches that the priesthood and the Levites' service are a perpetual statute throughout generations.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:23 affirms that the Levites' service and bearing of iniquity is a statute forever throughout generations, emphasizing the enduring nature of this covenant.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage echoes the theme of 'no inheritance of land for the priests' as stated in Numbers 18?
options: Joshua 13:14
Deuteronomy 10:9
Psalm 16:5
Ezra 7:6
questions.correctAnswer: Deuteronomy 10:9
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:9 echoes the theme by stating that the Levites have no inheritance among the children of Israel, aligning with Numbers 18:23-24.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the term 'heave offering' (terumah) as used in Numbers 18, and what does it signify in the context of the Levites' duties?
options: A gift lifted up, signifying dedication to God
A tax paid to the king
A penalty for sin
A harvest festival
questions.correctAnswer: A gift lifted up, signifying dedication to God
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for 'heave offering' (terumah) literally means 'lifted up' and signifies a gift dedicated and set apart for the LORD, as seen in Numbers 18:26-29 where Levites offer a portion to God.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Numbers 18:23-24 to emphasize the unique inheritance of the Levites?
options: Inclusio framing the Levites’ inheritance
Chiasmus highlighting the lack of land
Parallelism contrasting Levites and other tribes
Metaphor comparing inheritance to land
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasmus highlighting the lack of land
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:23-24 employs chiasmus by framing the Levites’ inheritance through a reversed order of ideas emphasizing their inheritance is the tithes, not land, reinforcing the exclusivity of their role.

questions.question: How does the teaching in Numbers 18 about the Levites’ inheritance and tithes foreshadow New Testament ideas about priesthood and offerings?
options: It foreshadows Christ as the eternal high priest who inherits no land but all authority
It predicts the abolition of priesthood in the New Testament
It suggests that only Levites can be saved
It points to the temple being destroyed
questions.correctAnswer: It foreshadows Christ as the eternal high priest who inherits no land but all authority
questions.explanation: The Levites’ lack of land inheritance but receiving tithes in Numbers 18 foreshadows Jesus' eternal priesthood as in Hebrews 7:5-6, where Christ is a priest after the order of Melchizedek with a superior, spiritual inheritance.

theological.title: Numbers Chapter 18 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Numbers Chapter 18 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to Numbers 18:1, what responsibility is given to Aaron and his sons regarding the sanctuary?
options: They shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary and the priesthood
They shall build the sanctuary
They shall only guard the sanctuary
They shall collect offerings for the sanctuary
questions.correctAnswer: They shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary and the priesthood
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:1 states that Aaron and his sons shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary and their priesthood, indicating their unique responsibility for the holiness and sin related to the sanctuary service.

questions.question: What does Numbers 18:6 reveal about the Levites in relation to the LORD?
options: They are given as a gift to Aaron to do the service of the tabernacle
They are excluded from the service of the tabernacle
They are to be the landowners in Israel
They are to offer sacrifices themselves
questions.correctAnswer: They are given as a gift to Aaron to do the service of the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:6 states that the Levites are taken from among Israel and given to Aaron as a gift from the LORD to serve in the tabernacle, showing their special dedication to God's service.

questions.question: What specific offering does God give to Aaron and his sons by reason of the anointing, as stated in Numbers 18:8?
options: The charge of the heave offerings of all hallowed things
The charge of the tithe of Israel
The charge of the entire land
The charge of the firstborn animals only
questions.correctAnswer: The charge of the heave offerings of all hallowed things
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:8 declares that God gave Aaron the charge of the heave offerings of all the hallowed things of Israel because of the anointing, signifying the priestly right to these sacred gifts.

questions.question: How are the firstborn of man and unclean beasts treated according to Numbers 18:15-16?
options: They must be redeemed by money according to the sanctuary's valuation
They are to be sacrificed without redemption
They are given as a gift to the Levites
They are excluded from any offerings
questions.correctAnswer: They must be redeemed by money according to the sanctuary's valuation
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:15-16 instructs that the firstborn of man and unclean beasts must be redeemed by paying five shekels or the sanctuary's valuation, showing God's provision for redemption even in consecrated things.

questions.question: What is the significance of Numbers 18:20 stating that the LORD is Aaron's inheritance among the children of Israel?
options: It shows that priests receive no land inheritance, as God Himself is their portion
It means Aaron is given a large land parcel
It declares Aaron the king over Israel
It mandates Aaron to distribute land to others
questions.correctAnswer: It shows that priests receive no land inheritance, as God Himself is their portion
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:20 emphasizes that Aaron and his descendants will have no land inheritance among Israel because the LORD Himself is their inheritance, highlighting the spiritual nature of their priestly reward.

questions.question: What doctrine about the priesthood is taught by the combined instructions of Numbers 18:1 and Numbers 18:7?
options: The priesthood is a sacred office bearing responsibility for sin and requires exclusive service
The priesthood is a temporary role for elders
The priesthood involves only teaching without sacrificial duties
The priesthood can be shared with any tribe
questions.correctAnswer: The priesthood is a sacred office bearing responsibility for sin and requires exclusive service
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:1 speaks of bearing iniquity of the priesthood, and 18:7 commands exclusive service and warns against strangers coming near, together teaching the doctrine of the priesthood's holiness and responsibility.

questions.question: How does Numbers 18:21-24 collectively describe the Levites' portion and inheritance?
options: The Levites receive all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance instead of land
The Levites receive land and tithes equally
The Levites are excluded from any inheritance
The Levites are given cities but no tithes
questions.correctAnswer: The Levites receive all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance instead of land
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21-24 shows that the Levites do not inherit land but are given the tithes of Israel as their inheritance for their service, teaching the doctrine of spiritual inheritance by provision rather than land.

questions.question: What attribute of God is revealed in His giving the Levites tithes as their inheritance according to Numbers 18:21?
options: God’s provision and faithfulness to sustain His servants
God’s wrath toward the Levites
God’s indifference to priestly service
God’s demand for land ownership
questions.correctAnswer: God’s provision and faithfulness to sustain His servants
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21 reveals God's attribute of provision and faithfulness as He provides the Levites all the tithes for their inheritance, ensuring their sustenance in their service to Him.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that tithes are a form of religious taxation imposed unfairly. What does Numbers 18:26-28 actually teach about the tithes given to the Levites?
options: Tithes are a divinely ordained inheritance for Levites, who must offer a portion back to God as a heave offering
Tithes are optional gifts freely given by the people
Tithes are collected only for the king’s treasury
Tithes are used to purchase land for the priests
questions.correctAnswer: Tithes are a divinely ordained inheritance for Levites, who must offer a portion back to God as a heave offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:26-28 teaches that tithes are God's appointed inheritance for the Levites, who themselves must offer a tenth as a heave offering to the LORD, indicating a sacred system rather than unfair taxation.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth about holiness and separation is taught by Numbers 18:3-4 regarding the Levites' service?
options: Levites must keep the charge of the tabernacle but not touch sanctuary vessels, lest death result
Levites can freely handle all holy objects
Levites are not responsible for sanctuary duties
Levites may share priestly duties with strangers
questions.correctAnswer: Levites must keep the charge of the tabernacle but not touch sanctuary vessels, lest death result
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:3-4 commands Levites to guard the tabernacle service but forbids them to approach sanctuary vessels or the altar, highlighting God's holiness and the required distinction in sacred duties.

questions.question: How do Numbers 18:9-13 illustrate the principle of sanctification in the offerings given to the priests?
options: Priests receive the most holy portions of offerings, which are sanctified for their use
Priests may eat any part of the offerings but must sanctify them first
All offerings are destroyed and not consumed
Offerings are shared evenly among all Israelites
questions.correctAnswer: Priests receive the most holy portions of offerings, which are sanctified for their use
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:9-13 explains that the most holy parts of various offerings are given to Aaron and his sons to eat in holiness, demonstrating the sanctification and consecration of priestly provision.

questions.question: What does Numbers 18:17-18 teach about the firstlings of clean animals and their use in worship?
options: They are holy and not redeemed; their blood is sprinkled on the altar and fat burned, but the flesh is given to the priests
They must be redeemed like unclean animals
They are sold to foreigners
They are burned entirely outside the camp
questions.correctAnswer: They are holy and not redeemed; their blood is sprinkled on the altar and fat burned, but the flesh is given to the priests
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:17-18 clarifies that the firstlings of clean animals are holy, not redeemed, and used in the altar service, with their flesh given to the priests as a sacred portion, illustrating sanctification and priestly provision.

questions.question: What does the combined teaching of Numbers 18:5 and Numbers 18:22 reveal about the danger of approaching the sanctuary improperly?
options: Improper approach to the sanctuary brings wrath and death upon the offender
Anyone may freely enter the sanctuary at any time
Only priests may approach but without consequence for others
The sanctuary is open to all Israelites
questions.correctAnswer: Improper approach to the sanctuary brings wrath and death upon the offender
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:5 warns that keeping the sanctuary charge prevents wrath on Israel, and 18:22 forbids Israelites from approaching the tabernacle lest they bear sin and die, emphasizing God's holiness and judgment.

questions.question: How does Numbers 18:19 reveal the nature of God's covenant with Aaron and his descendants regarding the heave offerings?
options: It is a covenant of salt, signifying an enduring and preserving covenant before the LORD
It is a temporary covenant that expires
It is conditional based on land ownership
It is a covenant solely with the Levites, excluding Aaron's daughters
questions.correctAnswer: It is a covenant of salt, signifying an enduring and preserving covenant before the LORD
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:19 describes the covenant concerning heave offerings given to Aaron and his family as a 'covenant of salt,' symbolizing permanence and faithfulness before God.

questions.question: Which combined doctrinal truth is taught by Numbers 18:26-28 and Numbers 18:29-32 about the use and sanctification of tithes?
options: Levites must offer a tenth of the tithes as a heave offering to God, and the remainder is their sacred reward to be eaten without guilt
Levites may keep all tithes without offering anything to God
Tithes are used to purchase land for the Levites
Tithes are burned entirely as a sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: Levites must offer a tenth of the tithes as a heave offering to God, and the remainder is their sacred reward to be eaten without guilt
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:26-28 commands the Levites to offer a tenth of the tithes as a heave offering to God, and 18:29-32 explains that the rest is their reward and must be eaten properly, teaching sanctification and proper stewardship of holy things.
